description: The aircraft in which Rudolf Perešin defected from the Yugoslav People's Army to Klagenfurt in Austria on 25 October 1991; stored for years at Klagenfurt then dismantled by ex-East German technicians and held at the Grossmittel tank base near Wiener Neustadt; returned to Croatia and put on display in front of the Ministry of Defence building in Zagreb in 2019; the reconnaissance variant is well attested in Croatian sources but no serial is confirmed by the sources I could reach and none is invented here; flown by the Yugoslav Air Force at the moment of the flight
aliases: MiG21; MiG-21R; L-14i; Fishbed; MiG21R; L14i
museum_name: Zrakoplov Rudolfa Perešina -- Ministarstvo obrane RH; Zagreb
